biggest_catch: Friend must have no existing or prior Citadel account relationship; business accounts and credit cards excluded from the credit card offer.
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Visa Reward Card for each qualified individual referred, for each offer completed (checking offer and/or credit card offer).
A referrer may receive up to $500 in Reward Cards per calendar year; limited to five (5) per calendar year.
Friend must be 18+, have no existing or prior Citadel account relationship, register via the referral link, then open a new checking account and/or credit card and complete the offer requirements.
Checking: one or more direct deposits totaling $250+ or 10+ debit card purchases within 60 days of opening; account open and in good standing 30+ days. Credit card: 10 transactions in 60 days.
Allow 4-6 weeks for delivery of the Visa Reward Card after all requirements are met.
Employees not eligible; referred person offer cannot be combined with other new-account offers.
Reward card may be reported as income to the IRS; recipient responsible for taxes.

steps: Register for the Refer-a-Friend program and send a ReferLive invitation to your friend by email or social media.
Friend registers via your link, then opens a new checking account and/or credit card.
Friend completes the offer requirements (checking: DD $250+ or 10 debit purchases in 60 days; credit card: 10 transactions in 60 days).
You earn $50 Visa Reward Card(s) (up to $500/year).
timing: Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are met.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after all requirements are met. — structural: the reward is fulfilled as a mailed physical card (4-6 weeks) — no electronic payout option per terms.
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The reward arrives as a physical card by mail (4-6 weeks); no expedite option exists in the terms — factor mail time into expectations.
